postTitle: Question for Scott - People profiting off the FNAF name
postSubject: Hey there,I was just wondering how you (and of course, the community) feel in terms of others using the FNAF name to make money. As an example, people who've been writing fan fiction about the game and then posting these books for sale online. Does it annoy you? Please you? Or are you just not bothered? :PThanks for reading!
commentSubject: It only annoys me because I have to have my lawyer do take-down notices, sometimes more. It's not ok to sell fan-fiction or fan-games, etc., because like you said, it's profiting off the FNAF name.
